mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO activity_purchase_reservation (request_id, user_id, activity_id, product_id, quantity, address_id, user_coupon_id, status, order_id, fail_reason, reserved_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{userId}, #{activityId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{addressId}, #{userCouponId}, #{status}, #{orderId}, #{failReason}, #{reservedAt})
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id, user_id, activity_id, product_id, quantity, address_id, user_coupon_id, status, order_id, fail_reason, reserved_at FROM activity_purchase_reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT id, request_id, user_id, activity_id, product_id, quantity, address_id, user_coupon_id, status, order_id, fail_reason, reserved_at FROM activity_purchase_reservation WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE activity_purchase_reservation SET status = 'CREATED', order_id = #{orderId}, fail_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) FROM order_item oi JOIN trade_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.activity_id = #{activityId} AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'CLOSED')

SELECT o.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS quantity FROM order_item oi JOIN trade_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.activity_id = #{activityId} AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'CLOSED') GROUP BY o.user_id

SELECT id, request_id, user_id, activity_id, product_id, quantity, address_id, user_coupon_id, status, order_id, fail_reason, reserved_at FROM activity_purchase_reservation WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
